Q: Good afternoon. This is a recorded statement for claim file reference that I will not read out. Please state your full
name for the record.
A: I'd rather just say I'm the driver of the blue sedan involved in the accident. I'll give you what I can.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the accident happened?
A: It was on a multi-lane road in Katy, Texas, near a shopping center. I was in the right lane getting ready to move
over into the middle lane because I needed to turn at the next light.
Q: What happened when you changed lanes?
A: I checked my mirror and saw nothing close, so I signaled and started to move. Then I felt a hard bump on the
driver's side. The other vehicle had come up in my blind spot and clipped my front quarter panel as it passed.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the contact?
A: Not clearly. I glanced at the mirror and it looked like it was far back. By the time I looked again it was already
beside me.
Q: Were you injured?
A: Yes. My right knee hit the loewr part of the dashboard when the car jolted. It swelled up within an hour and I've had
trouble putting weight on it since. I went to urgent care that evening and they took X-rays.
Q: Have you received any treatment since then?
A: I've been seeing a physical therapist twice a week and I was told I may need an MRI. I'm still working out whether I
need surgery.
Q: Did you speak with the other driver at the scene?
A: Briefly. He apologized and said he didn't see me. We exchanged insurance information and that was about it.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?
A: Only that my car has a dented door and a cracked headlight, and I'd like the repairs handled promptly.
Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
</page>

"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.

address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
